description: Source code for the AOT compiler in the PyTorch JIT mobile NNC backend, including functions for graph preprocessing, kernel compilation, and assembly output.

classes.name: torch::jit::mobile::nnc::CompilationUnit
classes.description: Class for managing compiled functions and their registration within the NNC backend.

classes.name: torch::jit::mobile::nnc::Function
classes.description: Represents a compiled function with methods for setting parameters, output specs, and kernel ID.

methods.name: toInputSpecs
methods.description: Constructs input specifications from the graph's inputs.

methods.name: findSymbolicShapePositions
methods.description: Locates symbolic shapes within input tensor shapes.

methods.name: compileMethod
methods.description: Compiles a TensorExprKernel into a Function object.

methods.name: aotCompile
methods.description: Performs ahead-of-time compilation of a graph into a Function and assembly code.

methods.name: writeOutputLlvmAssembly
methods.description: Writes LLVM assembly code to a file.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string by a separator into a vector of substrings.

methods.name: parseInputShapes
methods.description: Parses input shape strings into vectors of dimensions.

methods.name: parseInputTypes
methods.description: Parses input type strings into at::ScalarType vectors.

methods.name: parseInputMemoryFormats
methods.description: Parses memory format strings into at::MemoryFormat vectors.

methods.name: parseInputDynamicShapes
methods.description: Parses dynamic shape strings into vectors of dimensions.

methods.name: getNncKernelId
methods.description: Generates a unique kernel ID string based on model and method info.

methods.name: getNncKernelFuncName
methods.description: Generates a kernel function name string based on model and method info.

methods.name: preprocessGraphPasses
methods.description: Preprocesses the graph for compilation, including shape annotation and optimization.

methods.name: generateExampleInputs
methods.description: Generates example input tensors based on specified shapes, types, and formats.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Main entry point for graph preprocessing and compilation registration, returns serialized CompilationUnit.
